description: База данни, касаеща дейността на Националната комисия за борба с трафик на хора и информация за социалните услуги, разкрити към Комисията is a dataset listed in Open Data Bulgaria, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Администрация на Национална комисия за борба с трафика на хора.. Report on the activities of the SCCS for 2015; Register of legal persons providing social services at the NCCTP; List of victims of trafficking in human beings of the SCCSH; List of Centres for Victims of Trafficking in Human Beings of the SCCS. Coverage: Администрация на Национална комисия за борба с трафика на хора.. The portal shows the English title as "Database concerning the activities of the National Commission for Combating Trafficking in Human Beings and Information " (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Администрация на Национална комисия за борба с трафика на хора.. Its keywords include Министерски съвет. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-bulgaria.
